snippet.title: HorD: High or Die // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/777360/HorD_High_or_Die/

HorD is an arcady highscore-driven Twin-Stick-Shooter set in a dystopian Drug Film universe. The player is ordered by the ominous "Chick" to collect samples of a new drug named FLOW, but instead ends up using it, creating a drug induced gorefest and fighting his own nightmares.

Developed by
Flowmasters
